resolution.criteria:
Resolves on the first published FRED ICSA value for the week ending 2026-11-28, released around 2026-12-03; question asks whether it is above 189,000.
Later revisions do not count.
resolution.current_status: Latest official FRED value: 189,000 for the week ending 2026-11-21, updated Nov 25, 2026 7:34 AM CST; next release Dec 3, 2026 (as shown on FRED's page opened 2026-11-27).
edge_cases: Exact threshold: a first print of exactly 189,000 is not above 189,000 and would resolve No under a strict reading.
Only the first published value counts; the later revised figure for the week ending 2026-11-21 or 2026-11-28 is excluded even though FRED says all data are subject to revision.

The week is labeled by its Saturday end date (2026-11-28), but the print comes out Thursday 2026-12-03; a 2026-12-03 release that slips to a later day would still need to be the first published value for that week.
Times are stated in CST on FRED's page; the cutoff for 'published by 2026-12-03' depends on whether a time zone is applied.
